facts.fact: The academic paper identifies Casa de los Once Patios as the former Dominican convent and traces its later division and reuse, particularly 1932–1954. It is historical research, not proof of current museum operations or visitor admission.
facts.location: Printed p. 147, abstract; printed pp. 150 ff., historical narrative

facts.fact: The study places the convent on Calle Portugal and describes its historical connection to the Sagrario. The Sagrario, the former convent and the Basilica are connected by history but are distinct buildings/visits.
The study locates the former Augustinian temple, now the municipal public library, north of the square named Gertrudis Bocanegra. The square and library are distinct spaces.
facts.location: Printed p. 149, paragraph about the Augustinian order

facts.fact: The paper’s photograph caption identifies the arcades of the Sagrario atrium, supporting discussion of this architectural feature from the exterior; no article image is reused.
